decisive_items: SARS-CoV-2 antigen test positive (>5000 pg/mL) from oropharyngeal swab
Histology showed diffuse contraction band necrosis with several lymphocytes in cardiac muscle
response.rationale: The patient's positive SARS-CoV-2 test and elevated inflammatory cytokines, combined with cardiac symptoms and histological findings, make COVID-19-associated myocarditis the most likely diagnosis. While myocarditis is also a strong candidate, the specific link to COVID-19 infection tips the balance.

rejected.why: Absence of coronary artery disease makes acute coronary syndrome less likely
